title: hieracium solidagineum subsp. perthusianum
intro: Hieracium solidagineum subsp. perthusianum, commonly known as Perthus hawkweed, is a flowering plant species of the dandelion-like genus Hieracium. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium solidagineum subsp. perthusianum are believed to be due to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit potential antitumor activities, although further research is needed. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties, but more studies are required to confirm its effectiveness and safety for human use.
